title: Cohen structure theorem: a complete local ring has a coefficient ring
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a local ring which is $\mathfrak m$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] (the canonical map $R\to\varprojlim_nR/\mathfrak m^n$ is bijective), and let $p\ge0$ be the characteristic of the residue field $\kappa=R/\mathfrak m$. Then $R$ has a *coefficient ring*: a subring $\Lambda\subseteq R$ such that (1) $\Lambda$ is a local ring with maximal ideal $\Lambda\cap\mathfrak m$ and is $(\Lambda\cap\mathfrak m)$-adically complete; (2) the map $\Lambda/(\Lambda\cap\mathfrak m)\to R/\mathfrak m$ induced by the inclusion is an isomorphism; (3) $\Lambda\cap\mathfrak m=p\Lambda$ (so $\Lambda$ is a field when $p=0$).

source.place: Algebra, Theorem Tag 032A (theorem-cohen-structure-theorem, line 44929), part (1), and its proof (paragraphs 1-2: lifting $\kappa$ resp. a Cohen ring $\Lambda/p^n\Lambda$ through $R/\mathfrak m^n$ by formal smoothness, Proposition 0322 characterize-separable-field-extensions, Lemmas 0328 cohen-rings-exist, 0329 cohen-ring-formally-smooth); coefficient ring: Definition Tag 0326 (definition-coefficient-ring, line 44837); complete local ring: Definition Tag 0324 (definition-complete-local-ring, line 44786)

proof.text: The characteristic of the residue field is either prime or zero. In the prime case choose a Cohen ring C with residue isomorphism e, and lift it to f: C -> R by the Cohen-ring lifting theorem. Its residue equality identifies the comap of the maximal ideal with the maximal ideal of C and gives residue surjectivity.

In characteristic zero, lift the identity of the residue field to a section f: ResidueField R -> R. The source is a field, hence a local PID with zero maximal ideal and is complete for the zero ideal. The section equality proves both the comap identity and residue surjectivity.

In either case, apply the image theorem for a complete local PID whose maximal ideal is generated by p. The range of the constructed map supplies the coefficient subring and all four required clauses.

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 032A(1) and Definition 0326 (unchanged; it states (1)-(3) for an m-adically complete local ring, p >= 0 the residue characteristic). Wrote the proof in 7 steps following the Stacks proof of 032A: square-zero kernels m^{n-1}/m^n and the Q- resp. Z/p^n-algebra structures (elementary); p = 0: successive lifts of id_kappa through R/m^n by formal smoothness of kappa over Q (new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-char-zero-field-extension-formally-smooth, Prop. 0322) and the limit using completeness; p > 0: Cohen ring Lambda_0 (new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-cohen-rings-exist, 0328), successive lifts of Lambda_0/p^n -> R/m^n by formal smoothness of Z/p^n -> Lambda_0/p^n (new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-cohen-ring-mod-pn-formally-smooth, 0329), limit psi: Lambda_0 -> R, kernel 0 or p^N Lambda_0 (lem-weil-pbc-dvr-unit-times-uniformizer-power), and the verification of (1)-(3) for Lambda = psi(Lambda_0), which Stacks leaves implicit. Formal smoothness is used in the sense of def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic with n = 0 (Stacks 00TI). stmt_deps kept.

lean.statement: theorem exists_coefficient_subring (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R] (p : ℕ) [CharP (ResidueField R) p] : ∃ (Λ : Subring R) (hΛ : IsLocalRing Λ), letI : IsLocalRing Λ := hΛ maximalIdeal Λ = (maximalIdeal R).comap Λ.subtype ∧ IsAdicComplete ((maximalIdeal R).comap Λ.subtype) Λ ∧ Function.Bijective (Ideal.quotientMap (I := (maximalIdeal R).comap Λ.subtype) (maximalIdeal R) Λ.subtype le_rfl) ∧ (maximalIdeal R).comap Λ.subtype = Ideal.span {(p : Λ)}
